messages.subject: Re: Bug#944310: transition: r-api-bioc-3.10
messages.body_plain:
F.Y.I. A transition tracker has been set up:
https://release.debian.org/transitions/html/r-api-bioc-3.10.html

Andreas Beckmann wrote:
> Package: release.debian.org
> Severity: normal
> User: release.debian.org at packages.debian.org
> Usertags: transition
>
> Recently someone has started some R transition.
> I have no clue how this is supposed to work, r-bioc-biocgenerics now
>   Provides: r-api-bioc-3.10
> but rebuilding r-bioc-genomeinfodb in sid still generated a dependency
> on r-api-bioc-3.9 - perhaps the rebuild order must be followed strictly.
>
> Please set up a tracker manually, since this is a transition of a
> virtual package name.
>
> Ben file:
>
> title = "r-api-bioc-3.10";
> is_affected = .depends ~ /r-api-bioc/;
> is_good = .depends ~ "r-api-bioc-3.10";
> is_bad = .depends ~ "r-api-bioc-3.9";

messages.subject: sjPlot: `principal_components()` was removed and re-implemented in the **parameters**-package. Please use `parameters::principal_components()` now
messages.subject_clean: sjPlot: `principal_components()` was removed and re-implemented in the **parameters**-package. Please use `parameters::principal_components()` now
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

when trying to build r-cran-sjplot from Git I get:

...
* installing *source* package 'sjPlot' ...
file 'tests/testthat/test-tab_model.R' has the wrong MD5 checksum
** using staged installation
** R
** data
** inst
** byte-compile and prepare package for lazy loading
Error: object 'principal_components' is not exported by 'namespace:performance'
Execution halted
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package 'sjPlot'
...

In r-cran-performance I've found:

NEWS.md:* `principal_components()` was removed and re-implemented in the **parameters**-package. Please use `parameters::principal_components()` now.

OK, so checking ...

r-cran-sjplot(master) $ grep -R principal_components
R/sjTabItemAnalysis.R:#' @importFrom parameters principal_components
R/sjTabItemAnalysis.R:    pr <- parameters::principal_components(df, rotation = "varimax")
NAMESPACE:importFrom(parameters,principal_components)

I wonder why the build seems to refer to performance for
principal_components while the code says obviously parameters.

Any idea?

Kind regards

      Andreas.

-- 
http://fam-tille.de

messages.body_plain:
Hi Yihui Xie,

I intend to package bookdown for Debian (as a predependency for
rWikiPathways).  Debian considers minimized JS as binary without source
and thus I need to deliver the source for

   inst/resources/gitbook/js/app.min.js

Unfortunately I have no idea from where it is obtained from and thus I
fail to meet the requirement to provide it.  Any hint where you got that
file from?

Kind regards

      Andreas.

--
